activities.activity: Sleeping through the night, phone on silent on the nightstand.
Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, taking morning chronic-condition medication and checking blood pressure.
Dressing in work clothes, checking one-on-one text messages from relatives on the phone.
Making a simple breakfast, boiling the kettle, packing a lunch, and feeding the dog.
Walking the dog around the block in the cool morning air.
Doing the school run and drop-off before the shift starts.
Commuting by public transit to the clinic and school site.
On-site shift at the community clinic: patient intake, blood pressure and medication checks, and classroom aide duties at the primary school.
Taking a lunch break nearby, eating the packed lunch and texting family one-on-one.
Resuming on-site clinic appointments and school aide support, logging case notes in detail.
Commuting home by public transit.
Doing the afternoon school pick-up and stopping for a few cost-sensitive grocery items paid in cash.
Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and microwave, putting food in the refrigerator.
Eating dinner and unwinding after the shift.
Clearing the table, washing up, and loading the dishwasher.
Catching up on remote paperwork, community outreach notes, and appointment scheduling on the computer.
Sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbors, with the phone nearby.
Showering with the water heater and getting ready for bed.
Winding down with the TV and desk lamp on, taking evening medication.
Setting out tomorrow's clothes and replying to a final text message before sleep.
Sleeping, with the light off and the air conditioner on low.
